description: The devices of one track of an arrangement, controlled: its chain in a row, each device drawn by its own panel, racks with their macros, chains and zones, drum racks with their pads, devices dropped from a library where they go, and the end of the chain that opens the library or adds a rack. Every change is a command of the arrangement, and what a view remembers, such as a slot folded, goes through a hook you can give.
name: device-view
